initialization.marketer: Auth required during initialize; resources and templates calls failed before tool catalog.
initialization.documentation: Auth required during initialize as separate connection.
initialization.classification: Authentication required, not established as repo plugin scope or stale catalog. No authenticated tenant authorization yet established.

supportedRepair.existingInstalledCLI: ChatGPT bundled Codex CLI; standard mcp login marketer, no scope override or config override.
supportedRepair.needsActionTimeConfirmation: Codex access to Sitecore identity information plus persistent offline access. Stop before Allow Access until user explicitly confirms this exact grant.
supportedRepair.callback: Owned temporary loopback callback; no authorization URLs/state/codes/keys in repository.
supportedRepair.afterConsent: Complete supported Sitecore Identity and intended tenant selection, then read-only list-sites; refresh catalog only after authenticated success. Stop on unexpected grants or tenant scope.

userOrOperatorAction: Confirm the specific existing Marketer OAuth consent, including offline_access. No new token/manual credentials or permission changes requested.
